title: Paper retrieval candidate and escalation guards
description: Adds soft hook guards for paper candidate mismatch and retrieval escalation so obvious non-matches and premature broad reviews are surfaced without blocking native web-first lookup.

policy.candidate_guard: Warn when a specific-paper lookup returns content that does not share core terms with the query.
policy.escalation_guard: Warn when a specific-paper lookup context is being expanded into broad literature review too early.

rollback.notes: Remove the retrieval candidate and escalation warnings.
